items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Yeah, quite a few people set patterns after Billie Holiday. Billie Holiday came in the late years. ... She wasn't old as me when she died.

ctx.x: I think Billie Holiday was that way as a singer.

Yeah, quite a few people set patterns after Billie Holiday. Billie Holiday came in the late years. Billie Holiday came in the school president. I'm sorry. During the time of, my time or something. She wasn't old as me when she died. I'm just saying, you know.
She was that same kind of natural though as an artist, don't you?
